title: Chuck
description: Throw blocks to place them down!
body:
This mod lets you place blocks by throwing them. Good luck.

This mod is a data pack under the hood, and is compatible with vanilla clients. Support for modded blocks must be added manually by editing the data pack files.

Known issues:
- Cannot break or interact with other blocks while holding a block item (No fix planned)
- When blocks are crafted or obtained from loot, they are not stackable with other identical blocks until they enter the player's inventory (No fix planned)
- Shulker Boxes don't maintain the order of stored items when thrown
- Blocks that require certain supports can be placed in illegal positions when thrown
- Carrots and Potatoes cannot be thrown
- Blocks all share the same generic block placing sound
